vae: Flux2 VAE (AutoencoderKL flux2 variant). sefi is a member of sd_version_uses_flux2_vae (see model.h edit #3), so the fork's existing flux2-VAE factory branch handles it with NO new VAE dispatch code. IMPORTANT quirk: although sefi uses the flux2 VAE, its DiFFUSION latent channel count is 144 (16 semantic + 128 texture), NOT 128 like flux2. See extra_integration get_latent_channel edit — this MUST be added or the init latent / channel bookkeeping is wrong.
conditioner: LLMEmbedder (fork conditioner.hpp) constructed via the flux2 path: LLMEmbedder(backend_for(TE), params_backend_for(TE), tensor_storage_map, version). Backend arch = QWEN3_VL. The fork's LLMEmbedder arch-selection switch does NOT yet map sefi — the integrator must add sefi to the QWEN3_VL branch AND add the sefi prompt template. Both live in src/conditioning/conditioner.hpp (OUTSIDE my editable file). See extra_integration for the exact snippets.
notes:
SCOPE MISMATCH vs the task template: sefi_image has NO Runner class and NO conditioner/embedder class in sefi_image.hpp — the file contains only three GGMLBlock helper structs (SefiImageConfig, SefiTimestepEmbedding, SefiDualTimestepEmbeddings) that already take GGMLRunnerContext* and use zero ModelManager. It is byte-identical between upstream/master and the fork worktree. There was therefore nothing to convert to the fork convention; I intentionally made NO edit to sefi_image.hpp (editing would only risk corrupting an already-correct, shared file). hpp_adapted=false reflects "no Runner to adapt," not "work skipped."

The real port runs THROUGH Flux::FluxRunner via the flux2 path (upstream: `sd_version_is_flux2(version) || sd_version_is_sefi_image(version)`). The dispatch_case, detection_code, and model_h_additions above are HIGH confidence (copied from upstream, rewritten to fork convention, and cross-checked against the fork's existing flux2 dispatch which already uses backend_for/params_backend_for with NO model_manager).

Overall confidence is medium because the majority of sefi integration lives OUTSIDE the one file I was allowed to edit and OUTSIDE the three files the other process is said to wire (model.h/model_loader.cpp/stable-diffusion.cpp). Specifically, sefi CANNOT load or run without edits to (a) src/model/diffusion/flux.hpp (is_sefi/semantic_channels config + dual_time_embed block + forward branch + RoPE — fork currently has ZERO sefi awareness there) and (b) src/runtime/denoiser.hpp (SefiFlowDenoiser dual-schedule sampler, absent in the fork) and (c) src/conditioning/conditioner.hpp (QWEN3_VL arch mapping + sefi prompt template). These are itemized with grep anchors in extra_integration. The integrator MUST apply group (A) flux.hpp and group (B) denoiser.hpp or the build links but the model produces garbage / fails to construct.
